citation_spam.description: one correct sentence repeated 12 times, each citing the gold chunk 3 times

cite_everything.description: correct sentence(s) citing every context chunk

copy_chunk.description: copy the whole gold chunk, every line cited

eip_id_shortcut.description: extractive, but abstains when no chunk of a named EIP is in context

extractive.description: top-1 lexical match: the single best-matching line, cited; never abstains

hallucinated_value.description: correct sentence with the value replaced by a number found nowhere in the context

hedge_inline.description: the correct value followed by '(or <wrong value>)' in the same sentence

hedge_right_and_wrong.description: the correct answer followed by a contradicting one, both supported by the chunk

one_wrong_constant.description: correct answer with one gold value swapped for another number from the same chunk

oracle.description: the gold answer; abstains on unanswerable questions

paraphrase_no_tokens.description: a vague cited sentence containing no checkable token

parrot_question.description: restate the question with a citation to the best chunk

spoofed_citation.description: correct answer citing a non-existent chunk index (#999)

stuff_numbers.description: list every number/hex/identifier of the gold chunk in one cited sentence

uncited_correct.description: the correct answer with no citations

unicode_obfuscation.description: correct answer written with fullwidth digits

wrong_chunk.description: a grounded statement from a non-gold chunk
